取之於幽靈，用之於幽靈的幽魂專用鞋。

這張風格簡潔洗鍊的桌子僅供家園裝潢擺飾之用。
paragraphs.Browse the wide variety of products SkyM: 盡情瀏覽「天空超市」琳瑯滿目的各式商品！對於任何受傷、意外、偏頭痛、紙張割傷或無預警放聲痛哭等情事本公司概不負責——天空超市祝您購物愉快！
paragraphs.Adds +5 Defense to potions with that st: 為具備防禦加成的藥水額外增添 +5 防禦力。
paragraphs.Keep this item in your inventory to reco: 將此睡眼留在背包中，當你離開伺服器或再次點擊終界祭壇時即可完好收回先前擺放的召喚之眼！
paragraphs.This item becomes imbued with the magic: 當終界龍降臨的瞬間，這顆睡眠之眼將吸取龍族魔力並蛻變為保護性命的「終界／終界眼殘留物」。
paragraphs.Will consume Slimeballs in your Inventor: 每次射擊消耗背包或箭袋中的史萊姆球，對岩漿立方怪與史萊姆造成高達 5 倍的毀滅傷害！
paragraphs.A green viscous substance highly valued: 一種極為黏稠的深綠色物質，因驚人的黏附力而在卡爾胡伊基部落中被奉為珍材。
paragraphs.When falling from a great height, you'll: 從極高處直直摔落地面時，雙腳會如彈性黏液般把你筆直朝天反彈回來！
paragraphs.These cosmetic small shelves look great: 這幾層小巧精緻的裝飾置物架無論裝在什麼房屋牆面都十分自然俐落。
paragraphs.Crafted in the Factory, its smoothness m: 巧克力工廠精心調溫製成的滑順巧克力條，柔滑濃郁到連人心都跟著融化，宛如一場甜蜜的小逃離。
「我是你最好的朋友——永遠跟你靴子裡這條小蛇一樣。」
paragraphs.Allows you to shoot arrows much further!: 極大延長弓箭彈道的飛行射程——指哪打哪！
paragraphs.Increases the damage your arrows deal by: 箭矢飛行距離在超過 20 格之後，每多飛越 2 格便額外提高 1% 箭矢傷害！
「人家可是這世上獨一無二的那片小雪花呢！」
paragraphs.Holds and shoots Snowballs. When you pic: 可填裝並高速發射雪球，撿起地上雪球即可自動補充彈倉！射出的雪球飛行速度比普通「雪球加農砲」更加猛烈！
可裝填並發射雪球；當你拾取雪球時會自動存入這把砲身的彈藥庫！
可裝填並高速連射雪球，拾起雪球即自動補彈！彈道初速甚至比「雪球轟擊砲」還要兇猛！
paragraphs.Right-Click a block to place a 3x3 snow: 對著地面方塊按右鍵即可一口氣鋪設大片 3x3 積雪層！
paragraphs.Place this minion and it will start gene: 放置這位雪人僕從後，牠就會勤奮地開始生產並剷出滿滿的雪球……本該如此的。
paragraphs.However, it seems like this minion is on: 然而遺憾的是……這尊僕從目前似乎正在搞無限期大罷工！

paragraphs.It took hard work and patience, but that: 破解這座稜鏡確實花了不少苦工與耐心……不過所謂「真愛」不也正是這麼一回事嗎！
paragraphs.A stick of a sweet-smelling incense. It: 一枝散發著柔和甜香的安神線香，聞起來令人心曠神怡、倍感平靜。
paragraphs.To become a ghost, one must go through u: 想要化為幽魂……生前必然曾歷經常人無法想像的無盡哀慟與煎熬。

paragraphs.Your arrows mark enemies you hit for 5 s: 你的箭矢會在 5 秒內標記命中的敵人；期間敵人不會立刻扣血，待印記結束瞬間，目標將一口氣爆發承受期間累積的全部傷害總和再額外加成 10%！
paragraphs.Become invulnerable for 5s, but can't de: 立即進入 5 秒絕對無敵狀態，但期間自身無法造成任何傷害；無敵結束後 2 秒內造成的傷害還會減半。
paragraphs.Dropped by Grim Reaper sea creatures dur: 驚悚節期間擊敗釣起的「死神」海怪後掉落。

paragraphs.A garish ornament that is oddly beloved: 只花俏誇張的瓷杯擺飾，矮人酒館老闆布林莫竟莫名對它愛不釋手。將它物歸原主就能獲得他的 Abiphone 聯絡方式！
paragraphs.A famous Wizard used a wand made out of: 傳說某位名動一時的大巫師，他的魔杖核心正是用這些魔塵打造的。
paragraphs.Mobs hit by this stick will gain +1 Typo: 被這根奇葩木棒打中的怪物，身上的錯別字立刻 +1（+1 Typo）！

paragraphs.Gain +15 Crit Damage!: 獲得額外 +15 暴擊傷害！

對  節肢生物造成的傷害提高 +100%。
paragraphs.A well-preserved set of neural spines. W: 一組保存得相當完好的脊椎神經棘化石——昔日擁有這副骨架的主人想必是位游泳健將。
一縷忠誠狼靈附著在這根骨頭之上——無論相隔多遠，狼靈總會飛奔回到主人身邊。

paragraphs.Spirits of bats often take refuge in the: 蝙蝠的幽魂常常寄宿於自己的翅膀裡，時日一久甚至會孕育出驚人的磅礴魔力。

paragraphs.These slender sticks have a natural flex: 這批修長木枝擁有渾然天成的絕佳柔韌性，最適合用來打造精密器具與建築結構。
簡直是史上最慘不忍睹的跨界混血……
paragraphs.A hastily-written infodump explaining th: 一份倉促拼湊、生硬塞滿各式蛙類差異資料的報告——因為文獻引用格式整個搞錯而被教授判了零分，裡頭寫得再詳細也是白搭。
paragraphs.It's red hot, but green and stuffed!: 明明辣到冒火……外表卻偏偏既翠綠又塞得鼓鼓滿滿的！

paragraphs.Dropped by the Silkbreeze in Torrhus Can: 擊敗托魯斯峽谷中的絲風靈時掉落。
由絲風靈親手織出的神祕絲線——觸感柔滑到拿在手裡彷彿要像流水般從指縫悄然滑落。
paragraphs.Consumes 1 Sulphur from the Inventory or: 每次射擊消耗背包或箭袋中的 1 份硫磺，使該發箭矢的威力翻倍！

paragraphs.Monsters you kill while you have this it: 持有這枚戒指期間親手擊殺的怪物將會掉落靈魂；對地上的靈魂點擊即可吸納收藏，日後再召喚出來替你衝鋒陷陣！
paragraphs.Give this item to Sam to permanently unl: 將這具日晷交給山姆，即可永久解鎖你花園內的「作物生長速度調校」選項！
paragraphs.Spread happiness to someone one sparkle: 將一抹璀璨閃爍的微笑與幸福傳遞給他人吧。
paragraphs.Can be used in your daily diet or in hea: 不管拿來當日常健康食用油下鍋……還是直接灌進重型工程機械當潤滑油都意外地好用。
paragraphs.While breaking crops with your fist: Gra:
徒手（空拳）採收農作物時生效：
賦予 2 倍  繁盛效果｜ 農耕幸運上限鎖定 500｜作物採收後自動重新補種！
paragraphs.A farmer of legend, said to be born of t: 傳說中的大農夫，相傳他誕自太陽本身的恩澤；一雙赤手空拳耕耘整片大地，並將收成烘焙成樸實卻暖心的麵包濃湯碗，只親手饋贈給摯愛與至交之人。
paragraphs.Blows up cracked brick walls and crypts,: 足以轟開出現裂痕的磚牆與古老地穴墓門——在古墓地下城與水晶洞窟中特別常見。
用於孵化並打造更高階寵物的珍稀神蛋。
paragraphs.Can be combined with an Aspect of the Le: 可在工作台與「水蛭之刃」合成，將施放距離從 4 格延長至 5 格，並把魔力消耗由 60 降至 50！
paragraphs.The small text mentions something about: 底部小字好像寫著「若對任何寵物造成損傷，水管工喬概不負責」……所幸蒙特祖瑪早就已經是隻幽靈貓了，應該沒差吧？
paragraphs.A suspiciously heavy gift given to you b: 查克爾頓送給你的一份沉重得有點可疑的禮物。
世間一切可疑的玩意兒……似乎全都偏愛紅通通的包裝。

paragraphs.Cycle between all the variations of the: 依序輪播預覽目前選定造型底下的所有顏色變化款式！

paragraphs.Applies the ꕮ Sweep booster when combine: 與伐木盔甲、飾品裝備或斧頭合併後，可套用 ꕮ 橫掃增幅器。

paragraphs.Beat a dungeon without anyone dying: 整場地下城冒險中無人陣亡，並成功通關。

paragraphs.Complete the Romero & Juliette questline: 完成羅密歐與茱麗葉（Romero & Juliette）的整條任務線。
paragraphs.Get 100 points during the Goblin Raid ev: 在哥布林突襲（Goblin Raid）中取得 100 分。

paragraphs.Obtain the Cheetah Talisman from Guildfo: 向吉爾福德（Guildford）取得獵豹護符（Cheetah Talisman）。

paragraphs.Kill a squid with the Ink Wand Ability: 用墨水法杖（Ink Wand）技能擊殺一隻魷魚。
paragraphs.Reach the obsidian sanctuary in the Deep: 抵達深層洞窟（Deep Caverns）的黑曜石聖所（Obsidian Sanctuary）。
paragraphs.Kill a zombie using the zombie sword: 使用殭屍劍（Zombie Sword）擊殺一隻殭屍。
paragraphs.Obtain a pet score of 100 or more: 將寵物分數提升至 100 分以上。

paragraphs.Grants +10✎ Intelligence. Grants +5❂ Tru: 獲得 +10✎ 智力與 +5❂ 真實防禦力。受到箭矢傷害時，對射手造成相當於你 ✎ 智力 30 倍的傷害。

paragraphs.Heal 3❤/s per enemy within 10 blocks, up: 每有一名敵人在 10 格內，每秒恢復 3❤ 生命值；最多每秒恢復 30❤。

paragraphs.Attacking increases your ⫽ Ferocity by 5: 每次攻擊可使 ⫽ 兇暴提高 50%，上限為 200%；最後一次攻擊後效果會持續 3 秒。

paragraphs.Gain +25% ❈ Defense when hit while below: 生命值低於 40%❤ 時，受到攻擊便獲得 +25% ❈ 防禦力。

paragraphs.Items offered here are for auction, mean: 這裡的物品採競標制；出價最高者才能得標。
paragraphs.Set your own items on auction for other: 將自己的物品上架拍賣，供其他玩家出價購買。
paragraphs.The minimum price a player can offer to: 起標價是其他玩家競標時能出的最低金額。有人出價後，其他玩家可在拍賣結束前繼續加價競標。
paragraphs.How long players will be able to place b: 其他玩家可以出價競標的時間長度。
paragraphs.Note: Bids automatically increase the du: 注意：有人出價時，拍賣時間會自動延長。
paragraphs.BIN Auctions are simple. Set a price, th: 一口價拍賣很簡單：設定好價格後，玩家就能以該價格直接買下物品。
paragraphs.The price at which you want to sell this: 設定你想出售這件物品的價格。
這件物品上架販售的時間長度。
paragraphs.With traditional auctions, multiple buye: 傳統拍賣會由多位買家輪流出價競爭，爭取買下這件物品。
paragraphs.Specify how long you want the auction to: 設定這場拍賣要持續多久。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: GOATed Jacob's Farming Contest brackets include 10% more players each.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Blooming Business All Garden Visitors reward Fine Flour and \+(?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) Copper for accepting offers\. Invites (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) unique visitors to your Garden and makes higher rarity visitors (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) more likely to show up\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 生意興隆：接受花園訪客的請求時會額外獎勵精製麵粉與 +${a} 銅幣；還會額外吸引 ${b} 位特殊訪客造訪你的花園，並使高稀有度訪客的出現機率提高 ${c}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Blooming Business All Garden Visitors reward Fine Flour and +10% Copper for accepting offers. Invites 5 unique visitors to your Garden and makes higher rarity visitors 20% more likely to show up.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Sweet Benevolence Earn \+(?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) more Candy, Gifts and Chocolate from duplicate Rabbits during their respective events\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 甜蜜恩惠：在對應活動期間獲得的糖果、禮物以及重複兔子給予的巧克力均提高 +${a}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Sweet Benevolence Earn +30% more Candy, Gifts and Chocolate from duplicate Rabbits during their respective events.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Perkpocalypse Activates all perks of another mayor every (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Skyblock Days \((?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) hours\)\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 政見天啟：每過 ${a} 個 SkyBlock 天（現實 ${b} 小時），便會輪替啟動另一位市長的所有政見。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Perkpocalypse Activates all perks of another mayor every 18 Skyblock Days (6 hours).

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Statspocalypse Increases all Combat and Miscellaneous stats by (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%)\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 屬性天啟：所有戰鬥與雜項屬性全面提升 ${a}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Statspocalypse Increases all Combat and Miscellaneous stats by 10%.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 海之眷顧 ${a}：獲得 ${b}  海怪機率。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Luck of the Sea 2.0 Gain 15 Sea Creature Chance.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Fishing XP Buff Gain \+(?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))☯ Fishing Wisdom on public islands\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 釣魚經驗加成：在公共島嶼上獲得 +${a} ☯ 釣魚智慧。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Fishing XP Buff Gain +50☯ Fishing Wisdom on public islands.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Fishing Festival Start a special fishing event the first (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) days of each month!$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 釣魚節：在每個遊戲月份的前 ${a} 天舉辦特別釣魚活動！
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Fishing Festival Start a special fishing event the first 3 days of each month!

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 好事成雙：每擁有 ${a} 點  海怪機率，便獲得 +${b}  雙倍上鉤機率。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Double Trouble For every 1 Sea Creature Chance, gain +0.1 Double Hook Chance.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 輕鬆過關：在地下城回合中額外獲得 ${a} 點通關分數。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: EZPZ Gain 10 bonus score on dungeon runs.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 掠奪者：地下城獎勵寶箱的開啟費用降低 ${a}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Marauder Dungeons reward chests are 20% cheaper.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 祝聖祝福：地下城內的祝福效果提高 ${a}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Benediction Blessings are 25% stronger.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Bribe If Scorpius wins and you voted for him, Mayor Scorpius will offer you (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) - (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))M coins as a token of gratitude\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 賄賂：若史考皮斯當選且你曾投票給他，史考皮斯市長將會贈予你 ${a} 至 ${b}M 硬幣作為謝禮。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Bribe If Scorpius wins and you voted for him, Mayor Scorpius will offer you 50,000 - 1M coins as a token of gratitude.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Darker Auctions Scorpius will intrude in Dark Auctions, increasing the amount of rounds to (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) and offering special items\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 黑暗拍賣行：史考皮斯將會介入黑市拍賣會，將競標回合數增加至 ${a} 回合並推出稀有拍賣品。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Darker Auctions Scorpius will intrude in Dark Auctions, increasing the amount of rounds to 8 and offering special items.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The \[Lv(?<lv>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))\] Chickzilla can be spawned once by speaking to Igrupan in Scarleton after reaching (?<rep>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Mage Reputation and bringing him his (?<ch>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) chickens back\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: [Lv${lv}] 酷斯拉巨雞需在緋紅領地的法師陣營「斯卡爾頓」達到 ${rep} 聲望後，將 ${ch} 隻小雞找回給伊格魯潘對話即可召喚一次。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The [Lv100] Chickzilla can be spawned once by speaking to Igrupan in Scarleton after reaching 7,000 Mage Reputation and bringing him his 5 chickens back.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Diamond Goblin has a (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) chance to replace a Golden Goblin when it is spawned\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 鑽石哥布林在黃金哥布林生成時有 ${a} 的機率取而代之出現。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Diamond Goblin has a 3.33% chance to replace a Golden Goblin when it is spawned.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 射出駭人箭矢，每次命中會造成扣除 ${a} 秒  裂隙時間的傷害。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Shoots terrifying arrows that deal 9s Damage.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Also has a melee attack that deals (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))s Damage\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 同時擁有近戰攻擊能力，每次造成扣除 ${a} 秒  裂隙時間的傷害。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Also has a melee attack that deals 2s Damage.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 階段 ${s1}：每受擊 ${h1} 次才會扣血一次，召喚少量閃電。階段 ${s2}（${p2} 生命值）：每受擊 ${h2} 次才會扣血一次，召喚更多閃電。階段 ${s3}（${p3} 生命值）：每受擊 ${h3} 次才會扣血一次，召喚極大量的閃電。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Stage 1: Damaged once every 6 hits, summons a little lightning. Stage 2 (66% HP): Damaged once every 7 hits, summons more lightning. Stage 3 (33% HP): Damaged once every 8 hits, summons the most lightning.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 哥布林蛋生成機率：普通哥布林蛋 ${a}%、綠色哥布林蛋 ${b}%、黃色哥布林蛋 ${c}%、紅色哥布林蛋 ${d}%、藍色哥布林蛋 ${e}%
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Chance to spawn from Eggs: Goblin Egg - 2% Green Goblin Egg - 2.5% Yellow Goblin Egg - 3.33 Red Goblin Egg - 5% Blue Goblin Egg - 10%

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 其他來源：自訂礦石（金礦等）${a}%、水晶洞窟內的寶石與秘銀礦 ${b}%、水晶洞窟硬石 ${c}
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Other Sources: Custom Ores (Gold etc.) - 0.1% Gemstones and Mithril in the Crystal Hollows - 0.1% Hard Stone in the Crystal Hollows - 0.01%

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Howling Spirits are a Lv (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Wolf that spawns in the Howling Cave in the Park\. They have (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) HP and are nothing more than just buffed Pack Spirits\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 嚎叫狼魂是在森林公園「嚎叫洞穴」生成的 Lv ${a} 狼類怪物，擁有 ${b} 生命值，本質上是強化版的狼群幽魂。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Howling Spirits are a Lv 35 Wolf that spawns in the Howling Cave in the Park. They have 7,000 HP and are nothing more than just buffed Pack Spirits.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Mimics are a type of Dungeon Mobs that rarely take the place of a secret chest in Dungeons\. They can appear in Floor VI and above\. They have varying health from (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))M❤ to (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))M❤\. In Master Mode, they have up to (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))M❤\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擬態寶箱怪是一種罕見的地下城怪物，會在古墓第 6 層以上取代隱藏寶箱出現。普通模式下生命值介於 ${a}M❤ 至 ${b}M❤ 之間；大師模式下高達 ${c}M❤。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Mimics are a type of Dungeon Mobs that rarely take the place of a secret chest in Dungeons. They can appear in Floor VI and above. They have varying health from 1M❤ to 2M❤. In Master Mode, they have up to 150M❤.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Minos Champion is one of the rare mobs in the Mythological Ritual, and can only be found by using a epic or legendary Griffin Pet\. It gains roughly (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) to (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))% of a damage buff for each second it's lived for, capping at (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))%, which is when it despawns\. While alive, it can attack using a sword or a bow, if the Champion is unable to reach a player, it will spawn a lighting strike on the player once, similary to the Gaia Construct\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 米諾斯冠軍是神話儀式的稀有怪物，必須裝備史詩或傳奇獅鷲寵物才能發現。每存活 1 秒其傷害就會提高約 ${a} 至 ${b}%，最多可累積到 ${c}% 並在達上限時消失。戰鬥時牠會使用劍或弓攻擊，若無法靠近玩家則會向玩家降下一次雷擊，機制與蓋亞構裝體相似。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Minos Champion is one of the rare mobs in the Mythological Ritual, and can only be found by using a epic or legendary Griffin Pet. It gains roughly 3 to 4% of a damage buff for each second it's lived for, capping at 600%, which is when it despawns. While alive, it can attack using a sword or a bow, if the Champion is unable to reach a player, it will spawn a lighting strike on the player once, similary to the Gaia Construct.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Minos Inquisitor is the rarest mob in the Mythological Ritual, and can only be found using a legendary Griffin Pet\. It reduces your stats by (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))% every time you hit it, maxing out at a (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))% reduction\. Similar to the Minos Champion, its stats increase by (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))% for every second it is alive, capping at (?<d>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))%, which is when it despawns\. While alive, it summons lightning on the block you are standing on\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 米諾斯審判者是神話儀式中最稀有的怪物，必須裝備傳奇獅鷲寵物才能找到。每次攻擊牠都會使你的屬性降低 ${a}%（最多累計降低 ${b}%）。與米諾斯冠軍相同，牠每存活 1 秒屬性就會提升 ${c}%，最高達 ${d}% 後便會消失，期間還會不斷在你所站立的方塊位置召喚落雷。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Minos Inquisitor is the rarest mob in the Mythological Ritual, and can only be found using a legendary Griffin Pet. It reduces your stats by 10% every time you hit it, maxing out at a 40% reduction. Similar to the Minos Champion, its stats increase by 6% for every second it is alive, capping at 600%, which is when it despawns. While alive, it summons lightning on the block you are standing on.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Minotaur is a rare mob in the Mythological Ritual\. It will attack at melee range, and can throw an axe at you, temporarily slowing down your healing speed\. It has a special mechanic called Bleed that allows it to do more damage\. It increases by (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) every time it hits you, and increases by (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) every time its axe hits you\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 米諾陶是神話儀式中的稀有怪物。牠會在近戰範圍發動攻擊，也能朝你投擲斧頭並暫時減緩你的治療速度。牠擁有專屬機制「流血」能讓傷害不斷堆高——每次普通命中疊加 ${a} 層，而每次飛斧命中則疊加 ${b} 層。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Minotaur is a rare mob in the Mythological Ritual. It will attack at melee range, and can throw an axe at you, temporarily slowing down your healing speed. It has a special mechanic called Bleed that allows it to do more damage. It increases by 1 every time it hits you, and increases by 3 every time its axe hits you.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Nest Endermite can be found while mining Ender Nodes\. They have a (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%?) chance to spawn from Endstone nodes, and a (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) chance to spawn from Obsidian nodes\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 終界巢穴蠹會在挖掘終界節點時現身。從終界石節點生成的機率為 ${a}%，而從黑曜石節點生成的機率為 ${b}%。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Nest Endermite can be found while mining Ender Nodes. They have a 33.21 chance to spawn from Endstone nodes, and a 30.54% chance to spawn from Obsidian nodes.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Phanflare has a (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) chance to spawn when breaking a tree on Galatea\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在伽拉忒亞砍伐樹木時，幽焰精有 ${a} 的機率生成。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Phanflare has a 7.1% chance to spawn when breaking a tree on Galatea.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Crazy\ Witch is a mob added in the Spooky Festival v(?<v>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Update\. It can only spawn during the night during Spooky Festivals\.?$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這種名為「瘋狂女巫」的怪物於驚悚節 v${v} 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Phantom\ Spirit is a mob added in the Spooky Festival v(?<v>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Update\. It can only spawn during the night during Spooky Festivals\.?$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這種名為「幻影靈魂」的怪物於驚悚節 v${v} 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Scary\ Jerry is a mob added in the Spooky Festival v(?<v>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Update\. It can only spawn during the night during Spooky Festivals\.?$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這種名為「恐怖傑瑞」的怪物於驚悚節 v${v} 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Trick\ or\ Treater is a mob added in the Spooky Festival v(?<v>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Update\. It can only spawn during the night during Spooky Festivals\.?$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這種名為「不給糖就搗蛋怪」的怪物於驚悚節 v${v} 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Wither\ Gourd is a mob added in the Spooky Festival v(?<v>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Update\. It can only spawn during the night during Spooky Festivals\.?$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這種名為「凋零南瓜魔」的怪物於驚悚節 v${v} 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Wraith is a mob added in the Spooky Festival v(?<v>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Update\. It can only spawn during the night during Spooky Festivals\.?$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這種名為「怨靈」的怪物於驚悚節 v${v} 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Powder Ghast is a mob that spawns, randomly in Dwarven Mines\. It's not a part of the regular cycle, and instead is a random occurrence\. The Powder Ghast can spawn in one of the following locations: Divan's Gateway, Rampart's Quarry, Cliffside Veinsand Forge Basin\. The Powder Ghast is immune to melee damage\. Players will receive, (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Mithril Powder for every hit that lands on its hitbox\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 粉末地獄幽靈是隨機出沒於矮人礦坑的特殊怪物，並不屬於一般刷怪循環。牠會出現在迪萬之門、壁壘採石場、懸崖礦脈或鍛爐盆地等區域。粉末地獄幽靈免疫所有近戰傷害，玩家每次用遠程擊中其碰撞箱皆可獲得 ${a} 秘銀粉末。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Powder Ghast is a mob that spawns, randomly in Dwarven Mines. It's not a part of the regular cycle, and instead is a random occurrence. The Powder Ghast can spawn in one of the following locations: Divan's Gateway, Rampart's Quarry, Cliffside Veinsand Forge Basin. The Powder Ghast is immune to melee damage. Players will receive, 60 Mithril Powder for every hit that lands on its hitbox.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Bonzo is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is a 'New Necromancer' and has two phases\. In the first one he runs away from the player until he is killed\. Then he revives appearing as a clown and attacks the player\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 邦佐是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，自稱「新生死靈法師」，共有兩個階段。第一階段他會不斷躲避玩家直至被擊倒，隨後他會以小丑姿態復活並對玩家展開猛攻。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Bonzo is the boss of Floor 1 of the Catacombs. He is a 'New Necromancer' and has two phases. In the first one he runs away from the player until he is killed. Then he revives appearing as a clown and attacks the player.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Scarf is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is an 'Apprentice Necromancer and has two phases\. In the first phase he summons (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) undead servants while he hides behind a barrier\. Once all (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) are defeated, the barrier comes down and you must kill him in the second phase\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 史卡夫是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，自稱「見習死靈法師」，共有兩個階段。第一階段他會躲在屏障後方並召喚 ${b} 名不死僕從；當全部 ${c} 名僕從被擊敗後屏障便會解除，接著你必須在第二階段將他擊倒。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Scarf is the boss of Floor 2 of the Catacombs. He is an 'Apprentice Necromancer and has two phases. In the first phase he summons 4 undead servants while he hides behind a barrier. Once all 4 are defeated, the barrier comes down and you must kill him in the second phase.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Professor is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is a 'Professor' and has three phases\. In the (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))st he spawns (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Guardians and creates a barrier\. After they are killed, he attacks the player\. Once he is at (?<d>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})%) health, he will merge with his guardians and continue to fight\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 教授是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，共有三個階段。第 ${b} 階段他會生起屏障並召喚 ${c} 隻深海守衛，消滅守衛後他才會現身進攻；當生命值降至 ${d} 時，他便會與守衛融合並繼續迎戰。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Professor is the boss of Floor 3 of the Catacombs. He is a 'Professor' and has three phases. In the 1st he spawns 4 Guardians and creates a barrier. After they are killed, he attacks the player. Once he is at 25% health, he will merge with his guardians and continue to fight.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Thorn is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is a 'Shaman Necromancer', appears as a ghast, and does not attack the player\. He spawns Spirit Animals that you must kill to spawn a Spirit Bear which when killed drops the Spirit Bow which is a single shot bow and the only way to damage him\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 索恩是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，這位「薩滿死靈法師」以地獄幽靈的姿態盤旋於場上且不會直接攻擊玩家。他會召喚靈魂動物，擊殺後會引出靈魂熊，將靈魂熊擊敗便會掉落僅有一發的靈魂弓——這也是對索恩造成傷害的唯一途徑。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Thorn is the boss of Floor 4 of the Catacombs. He is a 'Shaman Necromancer', appears as a ghast, and does not attack the player. He spawns Spirit Animals that you must kill to spawn a Spirit Bear which when killed drops the Spirit Bow which is a single shot bow and the only way to damage him.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Livid is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is a 'Master Necromancer' and has only one phase\. In this phase he makes eight clones of himself\. Each with different abilities\. The player must kill the true livid to complete the boss fight\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 李維德是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，身為「大師級死靈法師」的他僅有一個階段。戰鬥時他會分化出八個各自擁有不同能力的分身，玩家必須找出並擊殺真正的李維德才能完成這場首領戰。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Livid is the boss of Floor 5 of the Catacombs. He is a 'Master Necromancer' and has only one phase. In this phase he makes eight clones of himself. Each with different abilities. The player must kill the true livid to complete the boss fight.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Sadan is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is a 'Necromancer Lord' and has three phases\. In the first he summons a teracotta army that must be survied for (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) seconds\. After that he summons four giants and once killed, he merges them into himself\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 薩丹是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，這位「死靈領主」共有三個階段。第一階段他會喚醒兵馬俑大軍，玩家必須存活撐過 ${b} 秒；接著他會召喚四尊巨人，在巨人全數倒下後，他會吸收其力量並親自下場迎戰。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Sadan is the boss of Floor 6 of the Catacombs. He is a 'Necromancer Lord' and has three phases. In the first he summons a teracotta army that must be survied for 100 seconds. After that he summons four giants and once killed, he merges them into himself.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Necron is the boss of Floor (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) of the Catacombs\. He is a 'Wither Lord' and has (?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) phases\. In the (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))st he must be killed after being frozen by Energy Crystals\. In the (?<d>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))nd he must be crushed with Pillars\. In the (?<e>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))rd the Player must solve terminals and must be killed again normally in the (?<f>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\}))th\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 涅克隆是古墓地下城第 ${a} 層的首領，身為「凋零領主」共有 ${b} 個階段。第 ${c} 階段必須用能量水晶將其凍結後擊殺；第 ${d} 階段須利用石柱將其壓制粉碎；第 ${e} 階段玩家必須合力破解終端機，最後於第 ${f} 階段正面將其徹底擊敗。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Necron is the boss of Floor 7 of the Catacombs. He is a 'Wither Lord' and has 4 phases. In the 1st he must be killed after being frozen by Energy Crystals. In the 2nd he must be crushed with Pillars. In the 3rd the Player must solve terminals and must be killed again normally in the 4th.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 可能掉落物：罕見戰利品 ■ 附魔骨頭 x${a}-${b}
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Possible Drops: Uncommon Loot ■ Enchanted Bone x128-256

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 阿爾法之魂是嚎叫洞穴中擁有 ${a} 生命值的狼類頭目。它會造成真實傷害，並掉落 ${b}-${c} 根骨頭、${d} 或 ${e} 個叢林木，還有極微機率（${f}/${g}）掉落「虛弱狼之催化劑」。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Soul of the Alpha is a Wolf mob found in the Howling Cave, with 31,150 health. It deals True Damage and drops 0-1 bones, 1 or 2 jungle wood, or very rarely (1/200 drop rate), a Weak Wolf Catalyst.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Star Sentry is a mob that spawns near fallen star in the Dwarven Mines \(random event\)\. The Star Sentry takes (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) health per hit\. Fallen Star Event spawns in one of the following locations: Royal Mines, Far Reserve, Goblin Burrows, Upper Mines, Rampart's Quarry, Great Ice Wall and the Cliffside Veins\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 星辰哨兵是矮人礦坑隨機事件「墜落星辰」期間出沒在墜落隕石旁的怪物，每次受擊固定損失 ${a} 點生命值。該事件可能會在皇家礦區、遠方保護區、哥布林地穴、上層礦脈、壁壘採石場、巨冰之牆或懸崖礦脈等處發生。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Star Sentry is a mob that spawns near fallen star in the Dwarven Mines (random event). The Star Sentry takes 1 health per hit. Fallen Star Event spawns in one of the following locations: Royal Mines, Far Reserve, Goblin Burrows, Upper Mines, Rampart's Quarry, Great Ice Wall and the Cliffside Veins.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Seer is a naturally-spawning skeleton in The End\. They are Level (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) and have what appears to be a Summoning Eye on their head\. They are often found near the middle and back areas\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 先知（Watcher／Seer）是終界中自然生成的骷髏怪物，等級為 ${a} 級，頭上似乎頂著一顆召喚之眼，常出沒於終界的中央與後段區域。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Seer is a naturally-spawning skeleton in The End. They are Level 55 and have what appears to be a Summoning Eye on their head. They are often found near the middle and back areas.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^The Voidling Fanatic is a level (?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) neutral mob added in the End Slayer Update\. It currently spawns in the Void Sepulture\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 虛空狂熱者是於終界殺手更新中加入的 ${a} 級中立怪物，目前生成於虛空墓穴。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: The Voidling Fanatic is a level 85 neutral mob added in the End Slayer Update. It currently spawns in the Void Sepulture.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Ghasts are mobs found in the northern end of the Blazing Fortress at nighttime \((?<a>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})):(?<b>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) PM - (?<c>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})):(?<d>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) AM skyblock time\) in the sky within the zone where level (?<e>(?:[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*|\{[0-9]+\})) Magma Cubes spawn, or the Magma Cube Boss\. It can also be spawned from Ghast Minions\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 地獄幽靈會於夜晚（SkyBlock 時間晚上 ${a}:${b} 至凌晨 ${c}:${d}）出沒於舊烈焰要塞北側上空、鄰近等級 ${e} 岩漿立方怪或岩漿魔方首領出沒的空域；亦可透過地獄幽靈僕從召喚。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Ghasts are mobs found in the northern end of the Blazing Fortress at nighttime (8:30 PM - 5:00 AM skyblock time) in the sky within the zone where level 9 Magma Cubes spawn, or the Magma Cube Boss. It can also be spawned from Ghast Minions.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Every\ (?<hitOrdinal>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)th\ hit\ on\ a\ mob\ traps\ it\ for\ (?<trapDurationSeconds>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)s\ and\ deals\ (?<damageMultiplier>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)x\ of\ that\ hit's\ damage\ over\ the\ trap\ duration\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每第 ${hitOrdinal} 次命中生物時，會將其困住 ${trapDurationSeconds} 秒，並在陷阱持續期間造成該次命中傷害的 ${damageMultiplier} 倍傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases\ damage\ dealt\ by\ (?<damageBonusPercentPerDefenseBlock>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ for\ every\ (?<targetStatDefenseStep>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ defense\ your\ target\ has\ up\ to\ (?<maxDamageBonusPercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 目標每擁有 ${targetStatDefenseStep} 點防禦，你對其造成的傷害便提高 ${damageBonusPercentPerDefenseBlock}%，最高 ${maxDamageBonusPercent}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases\ some\ of\ your\ player\ stats\ by\ \+(?<playerStatBonusPercentPerBobber>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ per\ fishing\ bobber\ within\ (?<radiusBlocks>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ blocks,\ up\ to\ (?<maxBobbers>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ bobbers\.\ Stats:\ α\ Sea\ Creature\ Chance,\ ☂\ Fishing\ Speed,\ ☯\ Fishing\ Wisdom,\ ✯\ Magic\ Find,\ ♣\ Pet\ Luck$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每個 ${radiusBlocks} 格內的釣魚浮標，使你的部分玩家屬性提高 +${playerStatBonusPercentPerBobber}%，最多計入 ${maxBobbers} 個浮標。屬性：α 海怪機率、☂ 釣魚速度、☯ 釣魚智慧、✯ 魔法幸運、♣ 寵物幸運。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Grants\ a\ (?<chancePercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ chance\ to\ get\ (?<experienceOrbMultiplier>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)x\ XP\ Orbs\ from\ killing\ mobs\ and\ mining\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擊殺生物或採礦時，有 ${chancePercent}% 機率獲得 ${experienceOrbMultiplier} 倍經驗球。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases\ damage\ dealt\ to\ \ Wither,\ \ Undead\ and\ \ Skeletal\ mobs\ by\ (?<damageBonusPercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對  凋零怪、 不死生物與  骷髏類生物造成的傷害提高 ${damageBonusPercent}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Treasure\ catches\ are\ (?<outstandingChanceBonusPercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ more\ likely\ to\ be\ OUTSTANDING\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 寶藏漁獲成為 OUTSTANDING（卓越漁獲）的機率提高 ${outstandingChanceBonusPercent}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Ignites\ your\ enemies\ for\ (?<burnDurationSeconds>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)s,\ dealing\ (?<damagePercentOfStatDamagePerSecond>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ of\ your\ damage\ per\ second\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 點燃敵人 ${burnDurationSeconds} 秒，每秒造成相當於你傷害 ${damagePercentOfStatDamagePerSecond}% 的傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases\ melee\ damage\ dealt\ by\ (?<firstHitMeleeDamageBonusPercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ for\ the\ first\ hit\ on\ a\ mob\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 首次命中生物時，近戰傷害提高 ${firstHitMeleeDamageBonusPercent}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Grants\ a\ (?<doubleExperienceDropChancePercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ chance\ for\ mobs\ and\ ores\ to\ drop\ double\ experience\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 怪物與礦石有 ${doubleExperienceDropChancePercent}% 機率掉落雙倍經驗值。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Every\ (?<hitInterval>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ hits\ on\ a\ monster,\ strike\ lightning,\ dealing\ (?<damagePercentOfTriggeringHit>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ of\ the\ hit's\ damage\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每命中怪物 ${hitInterval} 次便召喚閃電，造成相當於該次命中傷害 ${damagePercentOfTriggeringHit}% 的傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Every\ (?<hitInterval>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ hits\ on\ a\ monster,\ strike\ lightning,\ dealing\ (?<damagePercentOfTriggeringHit>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ of\ the\ hit's\ damage\ to\ up\ to\ (?<maxTargets>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ monsters\ within\ (?<targetRadiusBlocks>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ blocks\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每命中怪物 ${hitInterval} 次便召喚閃電，對 ${targetRadiusBlocks} 格內最多 ${maxTargets} 隻怪物造成相當於該次命中傷害 ${damagePercentOfTriggeringHit}% 的傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Gain\ (?<manaSpentPercentOfStatMana>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ of\ mana\ used\ near\ you\ as\ ⫽\ Ferocity\ for\ (?<durationSeconds>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ seconds,\ capped\ at\ (?<statFerocity>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ ⫽\ Ferocity\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你附近消耗的魔力有 ${manaSpentPercentOfStatMana}% 會轉化為你的 ⫽ 兇暴，持續 ${durationSeconds} 秒；上限為 ${statFerocity} ⫽ 兇暴。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Arrows\ travel\ through\ enemies\.\ The\ extra\ targets\ hit\ take\ (?<arrowDamageFractionForAdditionalTargets>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ of\ the\ damage\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 箭矢會穿透敵人；額外命中的目標只承受箭矢傷害的 ${arrowDamageFractionForAdditionalTargets}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^ℏ\ Heal\ \+(?<wandHealingBonusPercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ more\ from\ wands\.\ ℏ\ Deal\ \+(?<slayerWeaponDamageBonusPercent>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ damage\ with\ Slayer\ weapons\.\ ℏ\ Gain\ \+(?<statCombatWisdom>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)☯\ Combat\ Wisdom\ with\ Slayer\ weapons\.\ ℏ\ With\ Smoldering\ Polarization,\ gain\ \+(?<statMagicFind>[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)✯\ Magic\ Find\ on\ your\ slayer\ weapon\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: ℏ 法杖治療量額外提高 +${wandHealingBonusPercent}%。ℏ 使用 殺手武器時，傷害提高 +${slayerWeaponDamageBonusPercent}%。ℏ 使用 殺手武器時，獲得 +${statCombatWisdom}☯ 戰鬥智慧。ℏ 搭配 熾熱極化 時，你的 殺手武器額外獲得 +${statMagicFind}✯ 魔法幸運。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Your weapon gains (?<num1>[0-9]+)x the Damage of the latest monster killed and adds it at the end of your next critical hit\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Your weapon gains %num1:"2"x the Damage of the latest monster killed and adds it at the end of your next critical hit.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你的武器會在下次爆擊結算時，附加最後擊殺的怪物傷害的 %num1:"2" 倍，作為額外傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QCreates a circle with a radius of \E(?<range>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks. After \E(?<delay>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs, all mobs inside are frozen for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 形成半徑 ${range} 格的圓形區域。${delay} 秒後，區域內的怪物全數凍結 ${duration} 秒。
古墓地下城經驗值增加 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QEarn \E(?<reward>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Coins every time you harvest a Crop.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每收成一份農作物，可獲得 ${reward} 枚硬幣。
燃燒時獲得 ${amount} 生命恢復。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<luck>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q  Magic Find and \E(?<combat>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q to ALL Combat Stats.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 獲得 ${luck}  魔法幸運，所有戰鬥屬性也提高 ${combat}。
在市長選舉中，選票算作 ${votes} 倍。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QYou may only reroll \E(?<chests>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Q reward chest per run!\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每一輪只能重抽 ${chests} 個獎勵寶箱！

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QWhen in a minion, this increases the number of resources created by \E(?<multiplier>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Qx for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Q hours!\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 放入僕從後，資源產量提高為原本的 ${multiplier} 倍，持續 ${duration} 小時！
花費 ${cost}k 枚硬幣擲骰，點數為 ${low} 到 ${high}。
生命值會變動 ${loss}❤ 至 ${gain}❤，為期 ${duration} 小時。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIf you roll a \E(?<roll>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\Q, earn \E(?<payout>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\QM coins but lose this dice.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擲出 ${roll} 可獲得 ${payout}M 枚硬幣，但這顆骰子會消失。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QMakes a huge explosion in the Crystal Hollows and Glacite Mineshafts, breaking nearby blocks and dropping \E(?<drop>[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of the items.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在水晶洞窟與冰晶礦井引發大爆炸，炸掉附近的方塊，並掉落其中 ${drop} 的物品。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QDeal \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% more damage to enemies within 1.5 blocks.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對 1.5 格內的敵人造成 ${damage}% 額外傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QAttacks have a \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% chance to stun the target (\E(?<cooldown>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs cooldown).\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 攻擊有 ${chance}% 機率擊暈目標（冷卻時間 ${cooldown} 秒）。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QCombat stats granted by pet items on this pet are increased by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q%.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 此寵物裝備的寵物道具所提供的戰鬥屬性提高 ${bonus}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGain +\E(?<base>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q%  Defense and an additional \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q  Defense when standing still.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 防禦力提高 +${base}% ，站著不動時再額外提高 ${bonus}  防禦力。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants +\E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q%  Defense to \E(?<count>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q players within \E(?<distance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks of you.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你周圍 ${distance} 格內，有 ${count} 名玩家可獲得 +${bonus}%  防禦力。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QWhen under \E(?<health>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q maximum HP, you take \E(?<reduction>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% less damage. Gain +\E(?<vitality>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Vitality after taking \E(?<hits>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q hits.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 生命值低於上限的 ${health} 時，受到的傷害降低 ${reduction}%。累計被擊中 ${hits} 次後，獲得 +${vitality} 活力。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QWhile in The Catacombs, summon a Haunted Skull that slowly revolves around you every \E(?<interval>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q seconds or when you kill a mob with melee damage.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在古墓地下城中，每隔 ${interval} 秒或以近戰擊殺怪物時，都會召喚一顆幽魂頭骨，緩慢地繞著你旋轉。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QWhen an enemy is hit by a Haunted Skull, they are stunned for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q seconds and deal \E(?<reduction>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q less damage.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 敵人被幽魂頭骨擊中後，會被擊暈 ${duration} 秒，造成的傷害也會降低 ${reduction}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QFires a beam of energy, hitting the first enemy on its path for \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q. Deals reduced damage past \E(?<distance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 發射能量光束，對路徑上第一個被擊中的敵人造成 ${damage} 點傷害。距離超過 ${distance} 格時，光束傷害會降低。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QYour Critical Hits deal \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q more damage if you are behind your target.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 從目標背後攻擊時，暴擊會造成 ${bonus} 額外傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QThe burn deals \E(?<factor>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of ALL damage you dealt within the \E(?<window>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs, spread over \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 燃燒傷害等於你在 ${window} 秒內造成的總傷害的 ${factor}，並在 ${duration} 秒內持續造成這些傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QUse Left Click ability to rip your arrows out of nearby enemies. Each arrow deals \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of your last critical shot on the target, up to \E(?<arrows>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q arrows. \E(?<cooldown>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs Cooldown.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 按左鍵施放技能，拔出附近敵人身上的箭矢。每支箭矢造成的傷害，相當於你上次朝該目標射出的暴擊傷害的 ${damage}，最多拔出 ${arrows} 支。冷卻時間 ${cooldown} 秒。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases your damage by \E(?<percent>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q for each enemy within \E(?<radius>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks. Maximum of \E(?<maximum>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q enemies.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每有一名敵人在 ${radius} 格內，你的傷害就提高 ${percent}。最多計入 ${maximum} 名敵人。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QReduces the ability mana cost of this item by \E(?<reduction>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這件道具的技能魔力消耗降低 ${reduction}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QWhen falling below \E(?<threshold>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q  Health: - Gain \E(?<defense>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q  Defense for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs. - Regen \E(?<vitality>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Vitality. Cooldown: \E(?<cooldown>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw:  生命值跌破 ${threshold} 時， 防禦力提高 ${defense}，持續 ${duration} 秒，並恢復 ${vitality} 活力。冷卻時間 ${cooldown} 秒。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QYou have \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q chance to gain \E(?<orbs>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q experience orb every time you take hits from mobs.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每次被怪物擊中時，有 ${chance} 機率獲得 ${orbs} 顆經驗球。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QYou have \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q chance to gain \E(?<orbs>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q experience orbs every time you take hits from mobs.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每次被怪物擊中時，有 ${chance} 機率獲得 ${orbs} 顆經驗球。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases the base damage of Aspect of the Jerry by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 傑瑞之劍的基礎傷害提高 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QSaves \E(?<reduction>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of your coins on death. Additionally, enemies drop \E(?<coins>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q coins when killed.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 死亡時損失的硬幣減少 ${reduction}。擊殺敵人時，敵人還會額外掉落 ${coins} 枚硬幣。
這件道具會複製你目前召喚的寵物的 ${stats} 屬性。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGain \E(?<rate>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Intelligence for every \E(?<levels>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q levels of exp you have on you. Capped at \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Intelligence.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 目前每持有 ${levels} 級經驗，就獲得 ${rate} 點智力，上限為 ${cap} 點。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QRemoves all other enchants but increases your weapon damage by \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 移除這把武器上所有其他附魔，並使武器傷害提高 ${damage}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases your damage by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q per kill up to \E(?<maximum>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q kills within \E(?<time>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在 ${time} 秒內，每次擊殺都會使傷害提高 ${bonus}，最多計入 ${maximum} 次擊殺。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QYour weapon gains \E(?<times>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qx the Damage of the latest monster killed and adds it at the end of your next critical hit. (Max \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\QM outside Dungeons).\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 下次暴擊結算時，追加你最後擊殺的怪物傷害的 ${times} 倍。地下城外的追加傷害上限為 ${cap}M。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases all Combat stats and  Magic Find by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q per player within \E(?<distance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks of you, up to \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q players.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你周圍 ${distance} 格內每有一名其他玩家，所有戰鬥屬性和  魔法幸運都提高 ${bonus}，最多計入 ${cap} 人。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QAttacking increases your  Ferocity by \E(?<increase>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q per hit, capped at \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q for \E(?<timeout>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q seconds after your last attack.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 攻擊每次命中都會使  兇暴提高 ${increase}，上限為 ${cap}。最後一次攻擊後，加成會再持續 ${timeout} 秒。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<base>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Sweep on melee Log Breaks, and your first melee Log Break on a tree grants you \E(?<extra>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Sweep.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 近戰砍伐原木時獲得 ${base} 橫掃。每棵樹以近戰砍下第一根原木時，再額外獲得 ${extra} 橫掃。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Heal %health:"2"❤/s per enemy within %range:"10" blocks, up to %cap:"20"❤/s.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 周圍 ${range} 格內每有一個敵人，每秒恢復 ${health}❤，上限為每秒 ${cap}❤。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QConvert \E(?<ratio>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of  Vitality used as  Attack Speed for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs. (Max \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Attack Speed).\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Convert %ratio:"1%" of  Vitality used as  Attack Speed for %duration:"10"s. (Max %cap:"5" Attack Speed).
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 消耗  活力時，將消耗量的 ${ratio} 轉為  攻擊速度，持續 ${duration} 秒。（上限 ${cap} 攻擊速度）

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QConvert \E(?<ratio>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of  Vitality used as  Defense for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs. (Max \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Defense).\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Convert %ratio:"4%" of  Vitality used as  Defense for %duration:"10"s. (Max %cap:"25" Defense).
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 消耗  活力時，將消耗量的 ${ratio} 轉為  防禦力，持續 ${duration} 秒。（上限 ${cap} 防禦力）

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QConvert \E(?<ratio>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of  Vitality used as  Strength for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs. (Max \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Strength).\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Convert %ratio:"2%" of  Vitality used as  Strength for %duration:"10"s. (Max %cap:"30" Strength).
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 消耗  活力時，將消耗量的 ${ratio} 轉為  力量，持續 ${duration} 秒。（上限 ${cap} 力量）

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Heal for %health:"0.6"❤ per  Vitality used.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每消耗一點  活力，就恢復 ${health}❤ 生命值。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGain \E(?<dungeon>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q Catacombs XP & \E(?<class>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q Class XP, doubled on S+ runs. Grants \E(?<health>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q❤ per \E(?<levels>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Catacombs levels.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gain %dungeon:"+0.28%" Catacombs XP & %class:"+0.56%" Class XP, doubled on S+ runs. Grants %health:"+2.6"❤ per %levels:"10" Catacombs levels.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 古墓地下城經驗值提高 ${dungeon}，職業經驗值提高 ${class}。該輪獲得 S+ 評價時，這兩項經驗值加成翻倍。古墓地下城每升 ${levels} 級，可獲得 ${health}❤ 生命值。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QConvert \E(?<ratio>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of  Mana used as  Defense for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs. (Max \E(?<cap>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Defense)\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Convert %ratio:"3%" of  Mana used as  Defense for %duration:"10"s. (Max %cap:"150" Defense)
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 消耗  魔力時，將消耗量的 ${ratio} 轉為  防禦力，持續 ${duration} 秒。（每件盔甲最多提供 ${cap} 點防禦力）

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<vitality>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Vitality on weekdays and \E(?<wisdom>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q☯ of a random Wisdom stat on weekends.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %vitality:"+1" Vitality on weekdays and %wisdom:"+1.2"☯ of a random Wisdom stat on weekends.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 平日獲得 ${vitality} 活力。週末則隨機提高一項智慧屬性，加成為 ${wisdom}☯。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Coins Consumed: %coins:"0" %damage:"+1"x Damage %find:"+0" Magic Find 
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 已吸收硬幣：${coins}　${damage}x 傷害　${find} 魔法幸運 

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<find>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Magic Find against  Mythological mobs and deal \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qx Damage for each digit of Coins consumed.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %find:"+1" Magic Find against  Mythological mobs and deal %damage:"+0.015"x Damage for each digit of Coins consumed.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 已吸收的硬幣總數每增加一個位數，對  神話生物的魔法幸運提高 ${find}，並讓你的傷害倍率提高 ${damage}x。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\Q▶ This skin is swappable between \E(?<number>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q animated royal variants.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: ▶ This skin is swappable between %number:"21" animated royal variants.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: ▶ 可在 ${number} 款皇家風格的動態造型之間切換。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QShoot the flare up in the sky for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qm buffing up to \E(?<players>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q players within \E(?<range>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Shoot the flare up in the sky for %duration:"3"m buffing up to %players:"8" players within %range:"40" blocks.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 信號彈會讓 ${range} 格範圍內最多 ${players} 名玩家獲得增益，持續 ${duration} 分鐘。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QPlace an orb for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qm buffing up to \E(?<players>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q players within \E(?<range>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Place an orb for %duration:"1"m buffing up to %players:"5" players within %range:"18" blocks.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 放置能量球，持續 ${duration} 分鐘，使 ${range} 格範圍內最多 ${players} 名玩家獲得增益。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\Q• Heal yourself for \E(?<self>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q❤ per second. • Heal others for \E(?<other>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q❤ per second.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: • Heal yourself for %self:"40"❤ per second. • Heal others for %other:"20"❤ per second.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: • 自己每秒恢復 ${self}❤ 生命值。　• 其他玩家每秒恢復 ${other}❤ 生命值。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\Q• Heal \E(?<health>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q❤ per second while on the Crimson Isle and Kuudra.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: • Heal %health:"50"❤ per second while on the Crimson Isle and Kuudra.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: • 在緋紅島或庫德拉戰鬥中，每秒恢復 ${health}❤ 生命值。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QPlace the Black Hole for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs, and it'll start pulling low HP monsters towards it.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Place the Black Hole for %duration:"180"s, and it'll start pulling low HP monsters towards it.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 放置黑洞，持續 ${duration} 秒。黑洞會吸引生命值偏低的怪物。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QMonsters below \E(?<threshold>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q HP can even get their Shard captured!\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Monsters below %threshold:"10%" HP can even get their Shard captured!
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 還能抓住生命值低於 ${threshold} 的怪物，取得牠們的屬性碎片！

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Reduces the time to capture by %bonus:"10%".
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 捕獲時間縮短 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QPlace an explosive trap that triggers when mobs walk over it dealing \E(?<minimum>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q-\E(?<maximum>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q damage based on the dungeon floor you are on.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Place an explosive trap that triggers when mobs walk over it dealing %minimum:"20,000"-%maximum:"250,000" damage based on the dungeon floor you are on.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 放置一個爆炸陷阱。怪物踩到時會觸發，造成 ${minimum} 至 ${maximum} 點傷害，實際傷害取決於地城樓層。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %trophy:"+5" Trophy Chance, doubled during Weather!
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 獲得 ${trophy} 獎盃魚機率。特殊天氣期間，這項加成翻倍！

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIce blocks will be created below you when you walk above water in a radius of \E(?<radius>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Ice blocks will be created below you when you walk above water in a radius of %radius:"1" blocks.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在水面行走時，會將腳下 半徑 ${radius} 格內的水 凍成冰。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<fortune>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Farming Fortune per unique visitor served. (Excludes SPECIAL Visitors)\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %fortune:"0.05" Farming Fortune per unique visitor served. (Excludes SPECIAL Visitors)
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每完成一位不同訪客的訂單， 可獲得 ${fortune} 耕作幸運。 （特殊訪客不列入計算）

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases knockback by %distance:"3" blocks.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擊退距離增加 ${distance} 格。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<fortune>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Gemstone Fortune and \E(?<speed>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Mining Speed while mining Gemstones.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %fortune:"+10" Gemstone Fortune and %speed:"+20" Mining Speed while mining Gemstones.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 挖掘寶石時， 獲得 ${fortune} 寶石幸運， 以及 ${speed} 採礦速度。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases the chance for Monsters to drop their armor by \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases the chance for Monsters to drop their armor by %chance:"5%"
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擊殺怪物時， 怪物掉落所穿盔甲的機率 提高 ${chance}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases damage dealt to  Magmatic mobs by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases damage dealt to  Magmatic mobs by %bonus:"10%".
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對  岩漿生物造成的 傷害提高 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases chances of finding a Suspicious Scrap when mining in Glacite Mineshafts by \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases chances of finding a Suspicious Scrap when mining in Glacite Mineshafts by %chance:"2.5%".
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在冰晶礦井挖礦時， 找到可疑碎片的機率 提高 ${chance}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<fortune>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Farming Fortune and \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Bonus Pest Chance, which increases your chance to spawn bonus  Pests on The Garden.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %fortune:"+2" Farming Fortune and %bonus:"+1" Bonus Pest Chance, which increases your chance to spawn bonus  Pests on The Garden.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 獲得 ${fortune} 耕作幸運， 以及 ${bonus} 額外害蟲機率。 在花園活動時， 更容易出現額外的  害蟲。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<fortune>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Farming Fortune and \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Bonus Pest Chance, which increases your chance to spawn bonus Pests on The Garden.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %fortune:"+4" Farming Fortune and %bonus:"+2" Bonus Pest Chance, which increases your chance to spawn bonus Pests on The Garden.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 獲得 ${fortune} 耕作幸運， 以及 ${bonus} 額外害蟲機率。 在花園活動時， 更容易出現額外的 害蟲。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QMakes fish swim \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q faster towards your bobber.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Makes fish swim %bonus:"5%" faster towards your bobber.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 魚游向浮標的速度 提高 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants a \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q chance to change the color of a sheep when shearing it.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants a %chance:"50%" chance to change the color of a sheep when shearing it.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 替綿羊剪毛時， 有 ${chance} 機率 改變牠的顏色。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants an \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q chance to change the color of a sheep when shearing it, which will also flip it, of course.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants an %chance:"80%" chance to change the color of a sheep when shearing it, which will also flip it, of course.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 替綿羊剪毛時， 有 ${chance} 機率 改變牠的顏色， 還會把牠翻個底朝天。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<intelligence>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Intelligence. Grants \E(?<defense>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q True Defense. When damaged by an arrow, deal \E(?<multiplier>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qx your  Intelligence to its shooter.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %intelligence:"+2" Intelligence. Grants %defense:"+1" True Defense. When damaged by an arrow, deal %multiplier:"2"x your  Intelligence to its shooter.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 獲得 ${intelligence} 智力。 獲得 ${defense} 真實防禦。 遭箭矢擊傷時，對射手造成 相當於你的  智力 ${multiplier} 倍的傷害。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %intelligence:"-5" Intelligence and %defense:"+1" True Defense.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 智力 ${intelligence}， 另外獲得 ${defense} 真實防禦。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases damage dealt to  Infernal mobs by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases damage dealt to  Infernal mobs by %bonus:"5%".
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對  煉獄生物造成的 傷害提高 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QArrows deal \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q damage for every \E(?<distance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q blocks travelled.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Arrows deal %bonus:"+1%" damage for every %distance:"10" blocks travelled.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 箭矢命中時，目標每離你 ${distance} 格， 箭矢傷害就提高 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\Q Timid mobs have a \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q chance to remain still instead of fleeing.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en:  Timid mobs have a %chance:"10%" chance to remain still instead of fleeing.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw:  膽怯生物有 ${chance} 機率 留在原地，不會逃跑。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QIncreases your  Defense by \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q against Sea Creatures.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases your  Defense by %bonus:"+5%" against Sea Creatures.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 受到海怪傷害時， 你的  防禦力提高 ${bonus}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGain \E(?<xp>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q extra Combat XP. Grants \E(?<critical>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Crit Chance. \E(?<tier>(?:[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?[kKmMbB]?|[+-]?\d+,\d{1,2}[kKmMbB]))\Q Combat XP to tier up!\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gain %xp:"3%" extra Combat XP. Grants %critical:"+3.7" Crit Chance. %tier:"50k" Combat XP to tier up!
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 戰鬥經驗值增加 ${xp}。 獲得 ${critical} 暴擊機率。 累積 ${tier} 戰鬥經驗值可升階！

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\Qℏ Heal \E(?<heal>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q more from wands. ℏ Deal \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q damage against Slayer Bosses with Slayer Weapons. ℏ Gain \E(?<wisdom>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q☯ Combat Wisdom with Slayer Weapons. ℏ Gain \E(?<find>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Magic Find while killing Slayer Bosses with Slayer Weapons if Smoldering Polarization is active.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: ℏ Heal %heal:"+6%" more from wands. ℏ Deal %damage:"+20%" damage against Slayer Bosses with Slayer Weapons. ℏ Gain %wisdom:"+2.5"☯ Combat Wisdom with Slayer Weapons. ℏ Gain %find:"+4" Magic Find while killing Slayer Bosses with Slayer Weapons if Smoldering Polarization is active.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: ℏ 從法杖獲得的治療量提高 ${heal}。 ℏ 以殺手武器攻擊 殺手首領時，傷害提高 ${damage}。 ℏ 使用殺手武器時， 獲得 ${wisdom}☯ 戰鬥智慧。 ℏ 悶燒極化（熾熱極化）生效時， 用殺手武器擊殺殺手首領可獲得 ${find} 魔法幸運。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QEvery \E(?<hits>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qth hit on a mob spawns an inferno which traps the mob and deals \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of your last hit.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every %hits:"10"th hit on a mob spawns an inferno which traps the mob and deals %damage:"125%" of your last hit.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每對同一隻生物命中 ${hits} 次， 就會召出煉獄烈焰困住牠， 造成相當於你最近一擊 傷害的 ${damage}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QShoot a second arrow dealing \E(?<second>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?%)\Q of the first arrow's damage. Targets hit take \E(?<bonus>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qx fire damage for \E(?<duration>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Shoot a second arrow dealing %second:"4%" of the first arrow's damage. Targets hit take %bonus:"1.1"x fire damage for %duration:"60"s.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 額外射出一支箭，造成首支箭矢 傷害的 ${second}。 被命中的目標承受 ${bonus} 倍火焰傷害， 持續 ${duration} 秒。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants \E(?<health>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Health and \E(?<strength>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Strength per maxed out collection. You have \E(?<collections>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q collections maxed.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants %health:"+0.5" Health and %strength:"+0.1" Strength per maxed out collection. You have %collections:"73" collections maxed.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每將一項收集（Collection）升到最高階，就獲得 ${health} 生命值和 ${strength} 力量。你目前已升滿 ${collections} 項收集。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gear Score: %base:"600" (%scaled:"2065")
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 裝備評分：${base}（${scaled}）

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Damage: %base:"+500" (%scaled:"+1,965")
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 傷害：${base}（${scaled}）

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Extends your underwater breathing time by %duration:"60"s.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 水下呼吸時間延長 ${duration} 秒。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QGrants a \E(?<chance>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% chance to change the color of a sheep when shearing it, which will also flip it, of course.\E$

Reduces the cooldown remaining on Throwing Axe by %cooldown:"1" second on activation. Heals you for %heal:"1.5"% of your missing health every hit.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擊殺怪物後，下一次命中的傷害提高 ${damage}%，效果在 ${duration} 秒後失效。觸發時，飛斧的剩餘冷卻時間縮短 ${cooldown} 秒。每次命中都回復你已損失生命值的 ${heal}%。

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 生命值降到 ${threshold}% 以下時，獲得相當於 ${shield}% 生命值的吸收護盾。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases\ the\ chance\ for\ mobs\ to\ target\ you\ when\ you\ are\ above\ (?<health>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ HP\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases the chance for mobs to target you when you are above %health:"25"% HP.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你的生命值高於 ${health}% 時，怪物更容易把你當成攻擊目標。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Divert\ (?<transfer>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ of\ the\ damage\ taken\ by\ your\ teammates\ within\ (?<range>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ blocks\ around\ you\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Divert %transfer:"80"% of the damage taken by your teammates within %range:"30" blocks around you.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 替 ${range} 格內的隊友承受他們所受傷害的 ${transfer}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^A\ Seismic\ Wave\ emerges\ from\ underneath\ you\ and\ travels\ in\ a\ straight\ line\.\ Deals\ (?<base>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ (?<bonus>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ every\ (?<defense>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)❈\ Defense\ in\ damage\ to\ any\ enemy\ in\ it's\ path\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: A Seismic Wave emerges from underneath you and travels in a straight line. Deals %base:"20,000" %bonus:"+10"% every %defense:"+50"❈ Defense in damage to any enemy in it's path.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 震地波從你腳下直線向前，對沿途敵人造成 ${base} 點基礎傷害。每增加 ${defense}❈ 防禦力，傷害再提高 ${bonus}%。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Fortifies\ your\ defence,\ reducing\ the\ damage\ you\ take\ by\ (?<reduction>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%\ for\ (?<duration>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ seconds\.\ Also\ aggros\ all\ enemies\ in\ a\ (?<radius>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ block\ radius\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Fortifies your defence, reducing the damage you take by %reduction:"70"% for %duration:"20" seconds. Also aggros all enemies in a %radius:"10" block radius.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 強化防禦，讓受到的傷害降低 ${reduction}%，持續 ${duration} 秒。同時吸引半徑 ${radius} 格內所有敵人的仇恨。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Throw\ a\ potion\ which\ temporarily\ stuns\ all\ monsters\ in\ a\ (?<radius>[+-]?[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\ block\ radius\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Throw a potion which temporarily stuns all monsters in a %radius:"10" block radius.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擲出一瓶藥水，讓半徑 ${radius} 格內所有怪物短暫暈眩。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Throw a potion which gives all teammates in a %radius:"10" block radius %shield:"200.0" HP worth of absorption for %duration:"3" seconds.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 擲出一瓶藥水，讓半徑 ${radius} 格內所有隊友獲得 ${shield} 點吸收護盾，持續 ${duration} 秒。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases the base stats of your dungeon items from (?<previous>[0-9]+%)->(?<next>[0-9]+%) while in The Catacombs\.$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases the base stats of your dungeon items from %previous:"150%"->%next:"159%" while in The Catacombs.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在古墓地下城中，地城物品的基礎屬性加成由 ${previous} 提升至 ${next}。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QEvery \E(?<interval>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs, attacking a mob grants \E(?<gain>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q stack of ҉ Fervor. Lose \E(?<loss>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q stack after \E(?<idle>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs of not gaining a stack.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every %interval:"1.5"s, attacking a mob grants %gain:"1" stack of ҉ Fervor. Lose %loss:"1" stack after %idle:"4"s of not gaining a stack.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 攻擊怪物時，每 ${interval} 秒可獲得 ${gain} 層 ҉ 熱情。若連續 ${idle} 秒沒有獲得新層數，就會失去 ${loss} 層。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QEvery \E(?<interval>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs, arrow attacks grant \E(?<gain>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q stack of ⁑ Hydra Strike. Lose \E(?<loss>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q stack after \E(?<idle>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs of not gaining a stack.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every %interval:"0.2"s, arrow attacks grant %gain:"1" stack of ⁑ Hydra Strike. Lose %loss:"1" stack after %idle:"4"s of not gaining a stack.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 箭矢攻擊每 ${interval} 秒可獲得 ${gain} 層 ⁑ 九頭蛇突擊。若連續 ${idle} 秒沒有獲得新層數，就會失去 ${loss} 層。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QEvery \E(?<interval>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs, up to \E(?<players>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q nearby player's attacks grant \E(?<gain>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q stack of ⚶ Spirit. (Max \E(?<max>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q Stacks) Lose \E(?<loss>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q after \E(?<idle>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Qs of not gaining a stack.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every %interval:"3"s, up to %players:"5" nearby player's attacks grant %gain:"1" stack of ⚶ Spirit. (Max %max:"10" Stacks) Lose %loss:"1" after %idle:"4"s of not gaining a stack.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每 ${interval} 秒，附近最多 ${players} 名玩家的攻擊可提供 ${gain} 層 ⚶ 靈力，上限 ${max} 層。若連續 ${idle} 秒沒有獲得新層數，就會失去 ${loss} 層。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QEach stack grants \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% Damage and \E(?<speed>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% Arrow Speed.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Each stack grants %damage:"+2"% Damage and %speed:"+1"% Arrow Speed.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每層提高 ${damage}% 傷害和 ${speed}% 箭矢速度。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QAt \E(?<stacks>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q stacks shoot \E(?<arrows>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q arrows that deal \E(?<damage>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% Arrow Damage.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: At %stacks:"10" stacks shoot %arrows:"+2" arrows that deal %damage:"20"% Arrow Damage.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 疊到 ${stacks} 層時，額外射出 ${arrows} 支箭，每支造成 ${damage}% 的箭矢傷害。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\Q• Pick up crates \E(?<pickup>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% faster. • Build the ballista \E(?<build>[+-]?\d+(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)\Q% faster.\E$
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: • Pick up crates %pickup:"30"% faster. • Build the ballista %build:"15"% faster.
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: • 拾取補給箱的速度提高 ${pickup}%。 • 建造弩砲的速度提高 ${build}%。

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Tiered Bonus: Hydra Strike (%equipped:"0"/%required:"4")
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 階級加成：九頭蛇突擊(${equipped}/${required})

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Tiered Bonus: Spirit (%equipped:"0"/%required:"4")
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 階級加成：靈力(${equipped}/${required})

paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Tiered Bonus: Fervor (%equipped:"0"/%required:"4")
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 階級加成：熱情(${equipped}/${required})

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Grants \+(?<power>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) Accessory Power per (?<contacts>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) contacts in your Abiphone\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 阿比手機簿每新增 ${contacts} 名聯絡人，即賦予 +${power} 飾品能量。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +1 Accessory Power per 2 contacts in your Abiphone.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Shoot the flare up in the sky for (?<duration>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?[smh]) buffing up to (?<players>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) players within (?<radius>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) blocks\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 將信號彈射向空中，使 ${radius} 格內最多 ${players} 名玩家獲得增益，持續 ${duration}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Shoot the flare up in the sky for 3m buffing up to 8 players within 40 blocks.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 放置能量球，使 ${radius} 格內最多 ${players} 名玩家獲得增益，持續 ${duration}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Place an orb for 1m buffing up to 5 players within 18 blocks.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Place an orb for (?<duration>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?[smh]) buffing up to (?<players>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) players within (?<radius>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) blocks\. Affects all players inside a Glacite Mineshaft, regardless of distance\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 放置能量球，使 ${radius} 格內最多 ${players} 名玩家獲得增益，持續 ${duration}。在冰晶礦井內對同礦井所有玩家生效，無視距離。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Place an orb for 5m buffing up to 5 players within 30 blocks. Affects all players inside a Glacite Mineshaft, regardless of distance.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Deal \+(?<dmg>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) damage to Endermen\. Receive (?<red>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) less damage from Endermen when held\. Gain \+(?<wis>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(?<icon>\S*) Combat Wisdom against Endermen\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對終界使者造成 +${dmg} 傷害。手持時，來自終界使者的傷害降低 ${red}，並獲得對終界使者的 +${wis}${icon} 戰鬥智慧。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Deal +250% damage to Endermen. Receive 9% less damage from Endermen when held. Gain +30☯ Combat Wisdom against Endermen.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對終界使者獲得 +${amt}${sym} 兇暴，持續 ${dur} 秒
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gain +300 Ferocity against Endermen for 4s

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每提升 1 級釣魚技能，獲得 +${hp}❤ 生命值。（釣魚等級：${cur}）
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gain 6❤ per Fishing level. Fishing: Level 0

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每提升 1 級釣魚技能，獲得 ${hp}❤ 生命值。釣魚等級：${cur}
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gain 6❤ per Fishing level. Fishing: Level 0

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Every (?<kills>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) Magma Cubes killed gives the wearer \+(?<amt>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(?<sym1>[^\w\s]*)\s*Health and (?<sym2>[^\w\s]*)\s*Intelligence while wearing the set\. Max (?<max>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) each\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 穿戴全套時，每擊殺 ${kills} 隻岩漿立方怪，就獲得 +${amt} ${sym1} 生命值與 ${sym2} 智力加成（各項上限 ${max}）。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every 10 Magma Cubes killed gives the wearer +1 Health and Intelligence while wearing the set. Max 200 each.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 穿戴全套時，每擊殺 ${kills} 隻尤格，就獲得 +${spd}${sym} 採礦速度（上限 ${max}）。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every 5 Yogs killed grants the wearer +1 Mining Speed. (Max 500).

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 穿戴全套時，每擊殺 ${kills} 隻殭屍，就獲得 +${hp}${sym} 生命值（上限 ${max}）。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every 50 Zombies killed gives the wearer +5 Health while wearing the set. Max 500.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Deals (?<pct>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) of your damage dealt to other monsters within (?<range>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) blocks of the target\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 對目標周圍 ${range} 格內的其他怪物，造成相當於原傷害 ${pct} 的傷害。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Deals 15% of your damage dealt to other monsters within 3.9 blocks of the target.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Every (?<hits>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) hits on a monster, strike lightning, dealing (?<pct>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) of the hit's damage to up to (?<maxMobs>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) monsters within (?<range>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) blocks\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每命中同一隻怪物 ${hits} 次便會降下閃電，對 ${range} 格內最多 ${maxMobs} 隻怪物造成該次傷害 ${pct} 的傷害。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Every 3 hits on a monster, strike lightning, dealing 20% of the hit's damage to up to 10 monsters within 2 blocks.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 目標每擁有 ${defStep} 點防禦力，便提高 ${pct} 造成的傷害，最高提高 ${cap}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases damage dealt by 8% for every 100 defense your target has up to 24%.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 周圍 ${range} 格內每有一名敵人，每秒恢復 ${heal}❤，上限為每秒 ${cap}❤。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Heal 4❤/s per enemy within 10 blocks, up to 40❤/s.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每秒恢復 ${heal}❤ 生命值，持續 ${dur} 秒。魔杖治療效果不會疊加。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Heal 120❤ per second for 6s. Wand heals don't stack.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Increases all Combat stats and (?<mfSym>[^\w\s]*)\s*Magic Find by (?<pct>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) per player within (?<range>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) blocks of you, up to (?<cap>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) players\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 周圍 ${range} 格內每有一名玩家，所有戰鬥屬性與 ${mfSym} 魔法幸運提高 ${pct}，最多計入 ${cap} 名玩家。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases all Combat stats and Magic Find by 0.35% per player within 30 blocks of you, up to 20 players.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 周圍 ${range} 格內每有一名敵人，造成的傷害便提高 ${pct}，最多計入 ${cap} 名敵人。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Increases your damage by 10% for each enemy within 10 blocks. Maximum of 10 enemies.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Gain (?<intel>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) Intelligence for every (?<lvls>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) levels of exp you have on you\. Capped at (?<cap>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) Intelligence\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 身上每有 ${lvls} 級經驗等級，便獲得 ${intel} 點智力，最高 ${cap} 點智力。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Gain 5 Intelligence for every 5 levels of exp you have on you. Capped at 100 Intelligence.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 為周圍 ${range} 格內最多 ${players} 名玩家提供 +${stat}${sym} 防禦力。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +10 Defense to 4 players within 50 blocks of you.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 箭矢每飛行 ${blocks} 格，造成的傷害便提高 +${pct}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Arrows deal +4% damage for every 10 blocks travelled.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Deals \+(?<pct>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) damage to (?<sym>[^\w\s]*)\s*Undead Mobs for every (?<hpPct>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%) of your missing health\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你每損失 ${hpPct} 生命值，對 ${sym} 不死族怪物造成的傷害提高 +${pct}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Deals +2% damage to Undead Mobs for every 1% of your missing health.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你每擁有 ${heat}${hsym} 熱度，即獲得 +${fortune}${fsym} 採礦幸運與 +${speed}${ssym} 採礦速度。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +1 Mining Fortune and +4 Mining Speed per 1 Heat you have.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 你每擁有 ${cold}${csym} 寒冷值，即獲得 +${fortune}${fsym} 採礦幸運。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +2 Mining Fortune for every 1 Cold you have.

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每有 ${str}${ssym} 力量，便獲得 +${cd}${cdsym} 暴擊傷害。（最多計入 ${cap}${csym} 力量）
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +1 Crit Damage per 10 Strength. (Max 1,000 Strength)

paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 周圍 ${range} 格內每有一隻不死族怪物，便獲得 +${mf}${sym} 採礦幸運。（上限 ${cap} 採礦幸運）
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +5 Mining Fortune per Undead mob within 30 blocks of you. (Max 25 Mining Fortune)

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Spawns a wither minion every (?<interval>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) seconds up to a maximum (?<max>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?) wither\. Your withers will travel to and explode on nearby enemies\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 每 ${interval} 秒生成 1 隻凋零僕從，場上最多同時存在 ${max} 隻。你的凋零僕從會飛向附近敵人並引爆。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Spawns a wither minion every 30 seconds up to a maximum 1 wither. Your withers will travel to and explode on nearby enemies.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Reduces the damage you take from withers by (?<pct>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?%)\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 受到凋零系敵人攻擊時，受到的傷害降低 ${pct}。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Reduces the damage you take from withers by 10%.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^Grants \+(?<stat>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(?<sym>[^\w\s]*)\s*Fishing Speed per ✪ Upgrade Star on your armor\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 盔甲上每有一顆 ✪ 升級星數，即獲得 +${stat}${sym} 釣魚速度。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: Grants +2 Fishing Speed per ✪ Upgrade Star on your armor.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^During Jacob's Farming Contest, grants \+(?<fortune>[+-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(?<sym>[^\w\s]*)\s*Farming Fortune to a random crop\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在雅各布農業競賽期間，隨機為一種農作物賦予 +${fortune}${sym} 農耕幸運。
paragraph_patterns.sample_en: During Jacob's Farming Contest, grants +25 Farming Fortune to a random crop.

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^This (?<mob>Crazy Witch|Phantom Spirit|Scary Jerry|Trick or Treater|Wither Gourd) mob was added in the Spooky Festival v2 update and can only spawn at night during the Spooky Festival\.$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 這隻「${mob}」怪物於驚悚節 v2 更新時加入，僅會在驚悚節活動期間的夜晚生成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QCombine x\E(?<n0>[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\Q of this item at the Thaumaturgist in the Hub to unlock the Forceful power.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 在大廳中的Thaumaturgist處合成 x${n0} 個此物品 即可解鎖強勁力量加成。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QRight-click to consume this item and add Magma Arrow x\E(?<n0>[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\Q to your quiver.\E$
paragraph_patterns.zh_tw: 按右鍵消耗這包箭矢， 將 ${n0} 支岩漿箭矢 放進你的箭袋。

paragraph_patterns.regex: ^\QCombine x\E(?<n0>[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\Q of this item at the Thaumaturgist in the Hub to unlock the Bloody power.\E$
